    I really don't know why IM accounts are considered accounts, but here we are.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D306036

diff --git a/mail/base/content/modules/FolderSelectionDataAdapter.mjs b/mail/base/content/modules/FolderSelectionDataAdapter.mjs
index 57e9dab699f..272007ec363 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/modules/FolderSelectionDataAdapter.mjs
+++ b/mail/base/content/modules/FolderSelectionDataAdapter.mjs
@@ -91,7 +91,7 @@ export class FolderSelectionDataAdapter extends TreeDataAdapter {
       if (!serverOrServers) {
         // All the servers.
         serverOrServers = Array.from(
-          FolderUtils.allAccountsSorted(),
+          FolderUtils.allAccountsSorted(true),
           a => a.incomingServer
         );
       }
